name: task-server-admission-responsibility
goal: Preserve module responsibility and reject incomplete module metadata before task queue mutation.

evidence: ModuleTaskServerService.submit admits a task with an active committed module whose declared responsibility is non-empty. Expected task.moduleGoal to preserve that exact responsibility even when the incoming task omits moduleGoal; the focused existing service test currently receives undefined.

The module-tasks scenario already registers test/services/agents-providers/module-task.test.ts under services-agents-providers-module-task. Its existing admission case covered ModuleTaskService.add but not ModuleTaskServerService.submit or a missing-moduleGoal lifecycle. Extended that same registered case and title with a committed-contract fixture and exact moduleGoal assertion; case count stays fixed.
